voicePrivacy: Starting voice asks for microphone permission and sends audio to Relay's Google voice service in the United States. Relay does not save raw audio; captions and extracted details may be saved with your case. Use made-up details only. Never speak passwords, security codes or account credentials.
voiceExperimental: Experimental voice: check the captions and details carefully. You can stop and continue by typing at any time. Human Hindi and physical microphone reviews are still pending.
voiceReviewNotice: If details have not appeared, review your own spoken words as text. Nothing is sent automatically.
voiceReviewReplace: Check and edit the words below. Applying them replaces any unsent text draft. You must then press Send yourself.
voiceUnavailable: Voice is not enabled for this demonstration. You can continue by typing.
voiceFallback: Voice could not continue. Your saved report remains available. Continue by typing; no report has been sent automatically.
voiceNoCaptions: Captions will appear here when a voice session starts.

simText: The bank, authority and payment app are simulated. Nothing here goes to a real organization, and no money is held or recovered. Use only made-up details.
simBanner: Simulated institutions: demo environment. No real report or hold is made.
startPurpose: For people who have just been scammed: put the facts together and prepare reports for the right recipients.
startLead: See next steps with source references, then copy or download a recipient-specific draft to submit yourself. Relay does not file reports with real banks or authorities.
voiceLater: Voice arrives in a later phase. You can type now.
demoOnly: Demo data only. Please do not enter real personal details.
firstStop: Stop talking to the person who asked for money.
firstCodes: Do not share a code, PIN or password with anyone, including Relay.
firstBank: Contact your bank using the number on your card or in your bank's official app.
paceText: You can correct any detail. You do not need to know what kind of scam this was.
languagesText: Read and write in English or Hindi. Change language whenever you need.
privacyText: Your report is saved so you can return to it. Access expires after 72 hours. You can delete it sooner. Nothing is sent to a real institution.
consentText: Relay helps you prepare reports about a scam. This is a demonstration. Any bank, authority or payment app here is simulated, and nothing is sent to a real organization. Please use only made-up details. Your report is saved so you can return to it. Access expires after 72 hours; you can delete it sooner. Relay cannot promise that money will be recovered and does not give legal advice.
intakePurpose: Answer a few questions. You can type at your pace.
resume: Use the same browser to come back to this report.
chatEmpty: Start with what happened, how you paid, and when. Use made-up details only.
offline: You are offline. Your unsent words stay in this browser. Send them when you reconnect.
error: That didn't go through. Your answers are saved. Try again when you're ready.
connectionMissing: The demonstration is not connected yet. Your report has not been started.
blocked: Please use made-up details and leave out passwords, secret codes and card details.
factsPurpose: Check the details. Change anything that isn't right.
clock: It has been {{time}} since you paid
clockFuture: Check the payment time; it appears to be in the future.
uploadPurpose: We'll read it, then you check what we found.
uploadTypes: PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF or text. Up to 10 MB. Made-up details only.
uploadFailed: We couldn't read this file. Check the file type and size, then try again.
evidencePurpose: Check what we read from your screenshot. Fix anything that's wrong.
noDetails: No readable details were found. Try a clearer file, or type the details yourself.
injection: This file contains text that tries to give instructions to an assistant. We ignored it.
distressText: This is a hard moment. Being scammed is a crime done to you. You do not have to do this alone. Contact local emergency services or someone you trust right now. You can continue when you are ready.
deleteText: Your answers and uploaded files will be removed. This cannot be undone.
footer: Made-up details. Human decisions. No recovery promises.
future: This phase saves your report and evidence. Your next steps will be added in the planning phase.
validation: Check the value and try again.
authorized: Did you make or approve the payment yourself?
planWorking: Checking your details and preparing your next steps
planFailed: We could not finish your plan. Your report is saved. Try again.
planClarifyHelp: Answer in the conversation, or correct your country and payment details below. Then build your plan again.
planBuildHelp: Check your answers first. We will propose people to contact and show supporting sources where available.
planMinimum: Add your country, payment method, amount, payment time, contact method and whether contact has stopped before continuing.
planPurpose: A proposed contact order. Check the sources and unverified labels before acting.
planUnavailable: No plan is available yet. Check your answers and try again.
planDraftNotice: Demonstration draft: a human has not approved this guidance. Check official sources before acting.
planGeneric: General guidance: local reporting rules were not available. This does not establish local deadlines or eligibility.
planStale: Your answers changed after this plan was prepared. Update it before using these steps.
planTiming: Time since payment is context, not a legal deadline. A dated deadline appears only when supported by reviewed sources.
planEmpty: Some conditions could not be confirmed. Check your answers; no specific contacts were selected.
planPreviewChoice: Preview unreviewed draft guidance (synthetic demo only)
planDisabled: Planning is not enabled in this demonstration yet.
planReviewRequired: Reviewed guidance is not available. For made-up demonstration details only, you may choose the unreviewed draft preview. It is not approved advice.
moneyExplicit: Choose the currency explicitly. Both values are saved together; no currency is assumed.

messagesEmpty: Your recipient reports have not been prepared yet.
messagesPreparing: Preparing recipient reports and checking the details
messagesPrepareFailed: The report drafts could not be prepared. Your answers are saved. You can try again.
messageChoose: Choose a recipient above to check their report draft.
messageStale: Your answers or plan changed. Prepare current report drafts and check them again before use.
messageCheckFailed: The check could not finish. Review the draft carefully; simulated delivery is unavailable.
messageNoPromise: Preparing a report does not guarantee a refund or recovery.
messageMissing: This required detail is missing. Add it or say that you do not have it.
notAvailable: I do not have this detail
messageSaveFailed: The change was not saved. Check the details or reload the current version, then try again.
messageCopied: Draft copied for inspection. Nothing has been filed. Do not submit this demo draft to a real institution.
messageCopyFailed: Could not copy the text. Check your browser permission and try again.
messageSendBlocked: Simulated delivery requires a current, checked version without unsaved changes.
messageDelivered: Demo delivery recorded. Reference {{reference}}. No real institution received this.
messageConfirmText: This sends this report version only to a simulated {{recipient}}. No real institution receives it and no real complaint is filed. Check the named recipient before confirming.
messageSendFailed: The send could not be confirmed. Check the current status before trying again. No recovery or hold is implied.
messageDownloadFailed: The PDF could not be opened. Try downloading this saved version again.

evalReleaseObserved: One real hosted synthetic journey completed intake, a three-step plan, three automatically checked reports and a signed PDF download. No responses were mocked in this run.
evalReleaseLimit: One scenario, one run. This is a functional check, not a measured accuracy or reliability rate. Earlier quota failures remain unresolved evidence. Automated checks do not establish human legal review.
evalReleaseSecurity: Normal Firebase sign-in and App Check were used. Missing credentials and access from another owner were rejected.
evalReleaseReports: The three reports passed 23, 32 and 31 checks respectively. No delivery was approved. Bank, police and payment actions remain simulated.
evalReleaseCleanup: The signed PDF returned actual PDF bytes. Both synthetic test cases were deleted successfully.
evalReleaseOpen: Voice, source-building and cross-case linking cloud checks, human Hindi/source review, and comparative quality evaluations remain open. The calculator fixture below is separate from this hosted check.
